title: Field trials: smart prefetch pipeline for token cost reduction
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Run a focused field trial to validate a smart-prefetch + lightweight quantization flow that reduces per-token inference cost for short-chat workloads. Hypothesis: an adaptive prefetcher that pulls likely next-token KV prefixes combined with 8-bit activation quantization on tails will reduce token-level GPU time by >=15% with <1% end-user quality regression. Deliver a reproducible pilot runbook, dashboards, and rollout gating criteria to feed into Dedicated autoscaling and Optimize recommendations.
success_metrics: >=15% reduction in median GPU ms/token on pilot cohort
<1% increase in automated eval BLEU/ROUGE-like regression signals
cost per 1M tokens reduced by >=12% for pilot buckets
